sigmarsComet.description: While this spell is recharging, the fear and terror values of daemons are reduced by 1 for all who can see this radiant weapon.

conservative.requirements: S power. You must be able to touch a target weapon as part of casting the spell. Infuse a weapon with the radiant energy of Hysh. While this spell is recharging, the weapon glows with a pure white light. It counts as superior, and as such gains a fortune die {Df} to all attacks. If wielded against a daemon, it also gains +2 BL damage and all attacks Pierce 2 to that hit.

boon.description: Each daemon who can see your radiant light suffers 1 stress.

bane.description: The wielder of the weapon suffers 1 stress.

sigmarsComet.description: While this spell is recharging, the affected weapon's CR is reduced by 1 against daemons.

reckless.requirements: S power. You must be able to touch a target weapon as part of casting the spell. Infuse a weapon with the radiant energy of Hysh. While this spell is recharging, the weapon glows with a pure white light. It counts as superior, and as such gains a fortune die {Df} to all attacks. If wielded against a daemon, it also gains +2 damage and Pierce 2 to all attacks that hit.
